details.title: Assembly details
details.name: Name
details.languageDetected: Detected from the recording: this Session was started with Record now, so the first transcript decides the language of the analysis and the report. Choosing one here fixes it instead.
details.languageLocked: Locked: this assembly has started recording. The language decides how audio is transcribed, so changing it now would leave one assembly with transcripts in two languages.
details.autoPurge: Clear the audio off the table phones when the session is closed
details.autoPurgeHint: Every phone keeps a copy of its table's audio so that recording survives a bad network. This asks them to delete it once the assembly is finished — which matters most when participants used their own devices. A phone only ever deletes audio the server has already confirmed, so this cannot remove a last copy. Turn it off to keep the phones' copies until you have downloaded the export.
details.consentRequired: Required — a table records only once one person registered there has consented
details.consentOptional: Optional — the notice is shown and registration offered, nothing is blocked
details.consentHint: Each person registers individually on the table's phone or their own (name, optional email, explicit ticks against the notice the server renders). The record — who, what, which notice — is kept with the assembly and exported. Required is the setting for an organized assembly; Optional suits a spontaneous session.

aiLevel.light: Light — at most two nudges per session

details.aiHint: One short question or reminder on the table's phones when time runs out, the room goes silent or the discussion drifts — to the facilitator's own phone first when one is connected, and only then to the table. Each table can switch it off from its phone; the Live tab can pause it.
details.aiNotConfigured: Not set up on this server yet (Settings → AI).
details.redactNames: Names to keep out of the AI analysis
details.redactHint: Speaker labels are already anonymous, but people say each other's names out loud and the transcript records what was said. Names listed here — and any imported participant's name — are replaced with “Person A”, “Person B” before the transcript is sent to the analysis service. The transcript kept on this server is unchanged, so quotes in the report still show what was actually said. This does not affect the audio sent for transcription: use a self-hosted engine if that matters.
details.noDescription: No description. The name and language shown in the header are edited here.

instructions.title: AI analysis instructions
instructions.placeholder: E.g. This assembly is about urban mobility. 'PUMS' means the city's mobility plan.
instructions.empty: Optional context given to the AI when analyzing this assembly — topic, local glossary, focus areas.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting this assembly permanently removes every session, recording, transcript, finding and report. There is no undo and no backup.

rounds.deleteNoRecordings: The session and its tables will be deleted. It has no recordings.
rounds.deleteWithRecordings: The session, its tables and its {count} recordings will be permanently deleted, including the audio. | The session, its tables and its {count} recording will be permanently deleted, including the audio. | The session, its tables and its {count} recordings will be permanently deleted, including the audio.
rounds.emptyHint: Each session is one discussion with its own question, objective and duration.
rounds.title: Title
rounds.question: Question / prompt
rounds.endBeforeDelete: End the session before deleting it

promote.title: Add another session
promote.body: A Session is one discussion. With a second one this becomes an Assembly — an event of several sessions with the same people — and gets a name.
promote.confirm: Make it an Assembly and add a session

participants.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the link and copy it by hand
participants.imported: {count} participants imported | {count} participant imported | {count} participants imported
participants.registerTitle: Consent register — one row per recorded consent, with the notice texts
participants.csvHintAfter: — names and emails are optional. Anonymous labels are enough.

registration.title: Pre-registration link
registration.body: Send this before the event: people read the notice and register at home. At the door, "Find your name" on any table's phone seats them. One link for the whole assembly, valid 30 days, revoked with the table codes.

participants.emptyHint: Participants can stay fully anonymous — use “Prefill 50 anonymous” to generate P001…P050 in one click.
participants.removeMessage: {who} will be removed from this assembly.

tables.remixNote: {seated} seated · {pairs} pairs who already sat together | {seated} seated · {pairs} pair who already sat together | {seated} seated · {pairs} pairs who already sat together
tables.goalTitle: How to seat people for this session
tables.emptyHint: Tables are created with the session, from the assembly's table count. If that count was zero this session has no tables and no QR codes, and adding another session will not help — the assembly needs to be created again.
tables.unseatedHint: Randomly assign all participants to tables, or copy the previous session's seating.
